game.title: Burnout Paradise Remastered
game.distribution: Steam (app 1238080), activated and started through the EA app; Denuvo Anti-Tamper
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): launch -> intro -> main menu -> quit, windowed via config.ini. Our full-export 32-bit d3d11.dll logging proxy LOADS UNDER DENUVO, the game reaches the main menu, and the log shows D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=2 launches].

bindings.action: skip the intro movie / continue past the saving-icon notice

states.name: saving_icon_notice
states.detect: A notice explaining the saving icon; Enter continues.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: Enter Paradise City / Start a Party / Big Surf Island / Quit.

steps: launch through Steam (steam://rungameid/1238080); the EA app starts
wait for BurnoutPR.exe: ~140 s on the first run, ~6 s when the EA app is already running
a Windows Firewall prompt may appear on the first run (Cancel was pressed)
Down to Quit, verify the highlight
PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game window

config_files: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Criterion Games\Burnout Paradise Remastered\config.ini [Display]: Width=1280 Height=720 WindowMode=1 gives a 1296x759 window (client 1280x720); WindowMode=2 = borderless sized to the work area (3440x1392, WS_POPUP); WindowMode=0 (the original value) = fullscreen 3440x1440 [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1 each].
entry_points.proxy_dll: d3d11.dll beside BurnoutPR.exe: 32-bit, all 51 exports forwarded (staging/burnout-paradise-vr/proxy-d3d11-full). Loads under Denuvo; log shows D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=2 launches].

hazards.hazard: The first launch is slow and goes through the EA app
hazards.notes: ~140 s from the Steam launch to the process on the first run. Do not treat a missing process at 60 s as a failed launch.

hazards.hazard: A Windows Firewall prompt on the first run steals focus
hazards.notes: A Windows Defender Firewall 'allow access' dialog appeared on the first launch on this machine and took focus from the game. The main session pressed Cancel; answering it is left to the user. Losing focus can minimise a fullscreen game.
